title: 前 FBI 探員被控竊取近 $100 萬加密貨幣並用 ChatGPT 投資建議
content: Prosecutors say the former counterintelligence supervisor stole cryptocurrency from wallets tied to FBI investigations before asking ChatGPT how to invest the money and relocate to Europe.
summary_zh: 前 FBI 反情報主管從調查錢包竊取近 100 萬美元加密貨幣，並用 ChatGPT 規劃投資。

title: 什麼是 Air-Gapped Bitcoin 錢包？Coldcard 漏洞如何改變離線安全討論
content: Air-gapped wallets keep private keys completely offline, reducing exposure to hackers—but they're not immune from threats.
summary_zh: Air-gapped 錢包將私鑰完全離線，但仍無法完全避免 Coldcard 類型攻擊威脅。

title: BlackRock 在 Solana 與 Ethereum 推出代幣化貨幣市場基金
content: BlackRock launched a tokenized money market fund for stablecoin reserves that uses Solana alongside Ethereum.
summary_zh: BlackRock 推出代幣化貨幣市場基金，同時支援 Solana 與 Ethereum 作為穩定幣儲備。

title: XRP 持有者可借用 Ripple RLUSD 無需出售加密貨幣
content: Flare's FXRP has been approved as collateral in a $280 million RLUSD lending vault, allowing XRP holders to tap Ethereum's lending markets.
summary_zh: Flare FXRP 獲准作為 2.8 億美元 RLUSD 借貸抵押品，讓 XRP 持有者進入 Ethereum 借貸市場。

title: 加密隱私工具具「必要保護功能」：ChangeNOW 與 CoinRabbit 報告
content: Authoritarian oppression, corporate treasuries and “wrench attacks” make up the privacy case in a new report from ChangeNOW and CoinRabbit.
summary_zh: ChangeNOW 與 CoinRabbit 報告指出，隱私工具可對抗威權壓迫與 wrench attack。

title: 獨立 Bitcoin 礦工中獎，獲得 $200K BTC 獎勵
content: CKPool's developer put the winner's hashrate at a “wildly variable” peak of 100 PH, noting that it was probably rented.
summary_zh: CKPool 獨立礦工以峰值 100 PH 算力挖出區塊，獲得 20 萬美元 BTC 獎勵。

title: Trump 家族 American Bitcoin 持倉突破 8,000 BTC
content: The Hut 8 subsidiary increased its Bitcoin holdings by 14% in the second quarter even as Bitcoin’s price fell.
summary_zh: Hut 8 子公司 American Bitcoin 第 2 季持倉增加 14%，總量超過 8,000 枚 BTC。

title: Tom Lee 的 Bitmine 再買 10,399 枚 Ethereum 並執行股票回購
content: The crypto treasury company says it added another 10,399 ETH last week, bringing its holdings to nearly 5.8 million ETH as it pushes toward its goal of owning 5% of Ethereum's circulating supply.
summary_zh: Bitmine 上週新增 10,399 枚 ETH，總持倉接近 580 萬枚，並持續執行股票回購。

title: Morning Minute：Coldcard Bitcoin 駭客攻擊潛在損失近 $114M
content: Self-custody is under attack, and it's becoming increasingly clear that AI is one of crypto's leading threats.
summary_zh: Coldcard 攻擊潛在損失逼近 1.14 億美元，AI 成為加密貨幣主要威脅之一。

title: Strategy 出售 1.05 億美元 Bitcoin，美元儲備達 $4B
content: Half the proceeds funded preferred dividends and half went into an $81 million STRC buyback, its second in as many weeks.
summary_zh: Strategy 出售 1.05 億美元 Bitcoin，半數收益用於特別股息，另半數執行 8,100 萬美元 STRC 回購。

title: South Korean Exchange Bithumb Targets 2028 IPO
content: The exchange plans to file for preliminary listing review in 2027, after switching to international accounting standards this year.

title: Coldcard 損失逼近 $114M，小額 Bitcoin 轉帳量激增
content: Transfers of less than 1 BTC hit levels last seen days after the FTX collapse, while Galaxy Research flagged a likely fourth wave of thefts.
summary_zh: 小額轉帳（低於 1 BTC）量回到 FTX 崩盤後水準，Galaxy 警告第 4 波 Coldcard 竊盜。
